items.title: Add optional audit-only outcome fields to the Finding type
items.context: types.ts Finding: add optional signatureTag, resolutionType (enum), dismissReasonType (enum), resolveEvidenceStrength, dismissEvidenceStrength. Each annotated // audit-only — MUST NOT be read by any gate. Additive only; excluded from the finding signature domain.
items.userSees: Build is clean; the Finding type carries the new optional fields with audit-only comments; finding-verify signing is unchanged.

happy.desc: Create a Finding object with all new audit fields (signatureTag, resolutionType, dismissReasonType, resolveEvidenceStrength, dismissEvidenceStrength) set -> object is valid and fields are accessible; WHY: confirms type additions compile and are usable
Create a Finding object with NO audit fields set (all omitted) -> object is valid, fields are undefined; WHY: confirms fields are truly optional
Run finding-verify on a legacy finding (created before these fields existed) -> signature verification still passes; WHY: confirms new fields are excluded from signature domain

edge.desc: Create a Finding with only some audit fields set (e.g. resolutionType but not resolveEvidenceStrength) -> object is valid; WHY: confirms partial population is allowed, no accidental coupling between related fields
Run finding-verify on a finding WITH audit fields populated -> produces identical signature as the same finding WITHOUT audit fields; WHY: proves signature domain truly excludes audit fields

adversarial.desc: Grep advisory.ts and all gate logic files for references to signatureTag, resolutionType, dismissReasonType, evidenceStrength -> zero matches outside type definitions and smoke tests; WHY: static guardrail proving gate code never reads audit fields

Compute finding signature with signatureTag present on the Finding object vs without -> signatures are byte-identical; WHY: proves no accidental signature pollution even if field is present on the object

items.title: Capture the fields in finding_add/resolve/dismiss with optional enums and back-compat
items.context: cli-engine.ts schemas: finding_add += signatureTag?; finding_resolve += resolutionType?/resolveEvidenceStrength?; finding_dismiss += dismissReasonType?(OPTIONAL)/dismissEvidenceStrength?. finding.ts handlers: validate enums (reuse the evidenceState validation pattern) and store the fields. Legacy callers omitting the fields behave exactly as before.
items.userSees: finding_resolve/dismiss/add accept the new optional flags and persist them; omitting them works unchanged (back-compat); invalid enum values are rejected with a clear error.

happy.desc: Call finding_add with signatureTag="auth-bypass" -> finding persisted with signatureTag field present; WHY: confirms capture path for finding_add
Call finding_resolve with resolutionType="fixed", resolveEvidenceStrength="strong" -> finding updated with both fields; WHY: confirms capture path for finding_resolve
Call finding_dismiss with dismissReasonType="false_positive", dismissEvidenceStrength="medium" -> finding updated with both fields; WHY: confirms capture path for finding_dismiss
Call finding_dismiss with NO dismissReasonType (field omitted entirely) -> call succeeds, finding dismissed normally; WHY: proves dismissReasonType is truly OPTIONAL and back-compat preserved

edge.desc: Call finding_add with NO new fields at all (legacy caller) -> finding created identically to pre-Phase-1b behavior; WHY: back-compat regression guard
Call finding_resolve with resolutionType="fixed" but NO resolveEvidenceStrength -> succeeds, only resolutionType stored; WHY: partial field population is valid
Call finding_dismiss with dismissEvidenceStrength="weak" but NO dismissReasonType -> succeeds; WHY: confirms fields are independently optional

adversarial.desc: Call finding_resolve with resolutionType="INVALID_VALUE" -> rejected with clear enum validation error; WHY: proves enum boundary enforcement
Call finding_dismiss with dismissReasonType="sql_injection" -> rejected with clear error; WHY: adversarial garbage input
Call finding_resolve with resolveEvidenceStrength="" (empty string) -> rejected; WHY: empty-string edge for enum validation
Call finding_add with signatureTag containing special characters (spaces, slashes, unicode) -> either accepted or rejected gracefully, no crash; WHY: adversarial input for string field

items.title: Signature-registry in learning-store + minimal CLI; auto-propose on capture; gate-exclusion guardrail
items.context: learning-store.ts: read/write .lattice/learning/signature-registry.json (tags: {tag,status:active|proposed|deprecated,aliases,mergedInto,createdBy,approvedBy}). finding_add with a new signatureTag auto-records it as proposed. Add a minimal CLI (signature_registry_list + signature_registry_set with action propose|approve|alias|deprecate; active requires explicit approve) via a new handler + registry/cli-engine entries. Determinism guardrail: advisory.ts and gate logic never read signatureTag/resolutionType/dismissReasonType/evidenceStrength.
items.userSees: signature_registry_list shows tags; signature_registry_set --action=approve flips a proposed tag to active; a finding_add with an unregistered signatureTag leaves it status=proposed; advisory gate behavior is unchanged by any audit field.

happy.desc: Call finding_add with signatureTag="new-tag" (unregistered) -> signature-registry.json gains an entry {tag:"new-tag",status:"proposed"}; WHY: confirms auto-propose on capture
Call signature_registry_set action=approve tag="new-tag" -> status flips to active; WHY: confirms approve lifecycle
Call signature_registry_list -> returns all registered tags with status/aliases; WHY: confirms list operation
Call signature_registry_set action=alias tag="auth-bypass" aliasOf="new-tag" -> new-tag gains alias "auth-bypass"; WHY: confirms alias/synonym folding
Call signature_registry_set action=deprecate tag="old-tag" -> status becomes deprecated; WHY: confirms deprecation lifecycle

Compute advisory gate decision on a finding WITH audit fields vs identical finding WITHOUT audit fields -> decisions are byte-identical; WHY: THE LOAD-BEARING GUARDRAIL proving gate logic ignores audit fields

edge.desc: Call finding_add with signatureTag="existing-tag" (already in registry) -> no duplicate entry created, existing entry unchanged; WHY: idempotency of auto-propose
Call signature_registry_set action=approve on an already-active tag -> no error, remains active; WHY: idempotent approve
Call signature_registry_list when registry file does not exist -> returns empty list, no crash; WHY: cold-start tolerance
Alias tag "A" to "B" where B has mergedInto set -> verify alias chain resolution is handled; WHY: transitive alias edge case

adversarial.desc: Call signature_registry_set action=approve on a tag that was never proposed -> rejected or auto-creates as proposed then requires re-approve; WHY: cannot skip the propose step
Call signature_registry_set with action="DROP_TABLE" (invalid action) -> rejected with clear error; WHY: adversarial action enum
Call signature_registry_set action=alias with tag=aliasOf (self-alias) -> rejected or no-op; WHY: adversarial circular reference
Concurrent finding_add calls with different signatureTags -> all tags registered without data corruption; WHY: concurrency safety of registry writes

items.title: Smoke + npm script + no regression (back-compat, gate-exclusion, migration, signal enrichment)
items.context: tasks/experience-layer-finding-enums-smoke.ts + package.json test:experience-layer-finding-enums. Assert: optional capture + enum validation; legacy finding without fields unchanged (migration tolerance); audit fields NOT read by advisory.ts gate decision; signature-registry propose/approve/alias/mergedInto; finding-signals now produces non-zero signalScore when enums present. No regression in existing finding/usage-ledger smokes.
items.userSees: npm run test:experience-layer-finding-enums exits 0 'smoke passed'; committed verifier prints TOTAL N | PASS N | FAIL 0; existing finding-related smokes still pass.

happy.desc: Run npm --prefix packages/main run test:experience-layer-finding-enums -> exits 0 with output containing smoke passed; WHY: confirms the smoke script exists and passes
Smoke verifier output shows TOTAL N | PASS N | FAIL 0 -> all assertions pass; WHY: confirms committed verifier reports clean
Smoke asserts finding-signals produces non-zero signalScore when resolutionType=fixed is present -> signalScore > 0; WHY: confirms signal enrichment from enums
Smoke asserts legacy finding without any new fields still verifies (migration tolerance) -> passes; WHY: confirms old data is not broken
Smoke asserts signature-registry propose/approve/alias/mergedInto lifecycle -> all operations succeed in sequence; WHY: end-to-end registry lifecycle coverage

edge.desc: Run existing finding-related smokes (e.g. npm --prefix packages/main run test:finding-verify) -> still pass; WHY: no regression in pre-existing test suite
Run existing usage-ledger smoke -> still passes; WHY: no regression from Phase 1b changes

Smoke passes a finding through finding-verify with audit fields -> signature matches finding without audit fields; WHY: proves signature domain exclusion under real smoke conditions
